_comment: config.json is OPTIONAL for granola-sync as of v0.39. The daemon auto-discovers serverUrl + bearerToken from ~/.claude.json and reads the Granola API key from the macOS keychain (service: dent-brain.granola-sync). All filter behavior lives in user/filter.ts (authored via /dent-extensions setup granola-sync) — there are no filter fields here anymore. Override the cursor path only if you have a reason to.
